track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 23: Neyshaburak
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Neyshaburak in Mahur, Nava. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on G3 and dwells most on E in Neyshaburak. The line peaks at A3 (220.1 Hz) at 0:15.9. It closes on the tonic (G3 → G3 → G3 → G3 → G3 → E3).
